query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Analyze and triage Zendesk support tickets at scale: search ticket queues, enrich tickets with requester/order context, add private AI triage notes and tags, verify queues are drained, and aggregate product-support trends over a large historical ticket set.
query_ground_truth.query: fetch user profile and order history for ticket requester
query_ground_truth.rationale: Enriching a ticket requires looking up specific user details and context associated with the ticket.

results.execution_guidance: Found 3 tools for this query. Look at the schemas to know how to use them.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Zendesk provides customer support software with ticketing, live chat, and knowledge base features, enabling efficient helpdesk operations and customer engagement
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=zendesk. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="zendesk") to create a connection BEFORE executing any zendesk tools.

ZENDESK_GET_USER.description: Tool to fetch a single Zendesk user by numeric user_id. Use when you have a user ID from ticket payloads (requester_id, submitter_id, assignee_id, author_id) and need to enrich with full user details (name, email, role, organization_id, etc.).

user_id.description: The numeric ID of the Zendesk user to retrieve. This is the user ID found in ticket payloads (requester_id, submitter_id, assignee_id, author_id).

ZENDESK_SEARCH_ZENDESK_USERS.description: Search for Zendesk users by query or external ID. Use when you need to find users using flexible search criteria with Zendesk search syntax (e.g., partial name matches, email patterns, notes, phone numbers). For exact email lookups, consider using the 'Search Zendesk Users' action instead.

page.description: Page number for offset-based pagination (non-negative integer).

query.description: The `query` parameter supports the Zendesk search syntax for more advanced user searches. It can specify a partial or full value of any user property, including name, email address, notes, or phone. Example: `query='jdoe'`. See the [Search API](/api-reference/ticketing/ticket-management/search/).

include.description: A comma-separated list of sideloads to include in the response.

per_page.description: Number of records to return per page. Default and maximum values vary by endpoint.

external_id.description: The `external_id` parameter does not support the search syntax. It only accepts exact ID values.

ZENDESK_GET_ZENDESK_ORGANIZATION.description: Get metadata for a specific Zendesk organization by ID. Response fields are available under data.organization_info. Does not return member/user lists.

organization_id.description: Numeric ID of the organization to retrieve (e.g. 123456). Must be a non-null integer; cast to int if sourced from tools that return it as a string. Do not pass null (skip the call if ticket's organization_id is null). Obtain from ZENDESK_GET_ALL_ZENDESK_ORGANIZATIONS or ZENDESK_CREATE_ZENDESK_ORGANIZATION; never derive from organization name.

time_info.message:
- This is time in UTC timezone. Get timezone from user if you needed.
          - Always use this time info to construct parameters for tool calls appropriately even when the tool call requires relative times like 'last week', 'last 24 hours', 'today', 'tomorrow' etc.
          - Do not hallucinate the time or timezone by yourself.
